Dear [Mr Craik](/person/379)
I will soon send material for the other pages. I have a queer little drama half written, and one or two other things that only require to be got into shape[^1]

Yours truly

C M Yonge


[^1]: This was extra material to make up the collection of previously published stories which appeared as [Bye-Words](/book/135) (1879). The \'queer little drama\' was \'The Campbells are Coming\'.
